description: Change the document setup (Dokument einrichten) of an existing document: page size via preset (A4, Letter, Legal, Tabloid) or width_mm/height_mm, orientation (swaps width and height), facing_pages, pages (page count – a lower count deletes the last pages with their contents and needs allow_page_removal true), start_page_number. At least one parameter. Margins and bleed are set with set_layout_grid and set_document_bleed. Objects are not adjusted to a new page size – unless InDesign's own layout adjustment is active (Adjust Layout, or a liquid layout rule such as scale on a page or parent page): then InDesign moves or stretches them. adjust_layout false switches both off for this call only (rules and setting are restored afterwards), so objects keep their size; true switches Adjust Layout on for this call; omitted leaves InDesign's settings as they are and warns when a page size change met an active adjustment. To widen the inside margin (Bundsteg) without stretching frames use set_layout_grid with move_objects. Returns setup (read back), previous, pages_added, pages_removed, changed and layout_adjustment {requested, active_before[], layout_rules_suspended}; warns when the page size or facing pages changed.

adjust_layout.description: false: no layout adjustment for this call (Adjust Layout and liquid layout rules off, restored afterwards); true: Adjust Layout on for this call. Default: as set in InDesign.

allow_page_removal.description: Confirm that a lower page count may delete pages with their contents.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

orientation.description: Swaps width and height when they do not match.

pages.description: Page count. Fewer than now deletes pages (allow_page_removal).

start_page_number.description: Number of the first page (document preference; sections may override it).

name: set_document_setup
title: Change document setup
